# Calendar Event Manager Skill

Create macOS Calendar events that you cannot miss. Give the event, date, time and place, and get five tiered sound alarms, Blow, Sosumi, Glass, Ping and Funk, plus three coupled Reminders, TOMORROW, TODAY and at event time, across Mac and iOS. By @terrylica. macOS only, built on AppleScript, and it assumes Calendar and Reminders are set up.
